p1f736860ac.notes: Granite pavement plaque in Riga marking the first film screening, inlaid metal letters in a decorative Art Nouveau font (e/E and s shapes are unusual). The ļ in Brāļu is a stylised descending glyph; the comma below is merged into it. 'Parize' and 'Riga' show no macron on the i (Parīze/Rīga in standard spelling).

p32abd77ace.notes: Brass dedication plaque on the restored swan house in Riga ('the restored swan house was given to the city of Riga for its 800th anniversary by Andris Ārgalis, mayor of Riga 2000-2001'). Raised serif capitals with Latvian macrons and Ņ; frontal. The place name appears in the accusative (namiņu).

p349cb9a32f.notes: Brushed-steel label plate of the public artwork 'Rēgs' (The Ghost), Riga old town, trilingual. Only headings, author lines and URL are transcribed; the three small explanatory paragraphs (lv/en/ru, about the 'Art in the Public Space' programme of Boris and Ināra Teterev) are omitted. Reflections on the steel.

p551e3eeed0.notes: Orange-and-white pawnshop fascia on a pink Art Nouveau building, Riga, plus a round projecting VITA LOMBARDS sign. Distractor: green 'Banknote / AIZDEVUMI / LOMBARDS' fascia and hanging sign on the left (a different pawnshop), 'UZPĒRKAM ZELTU!' window posters, no-entry sign.

lines.text: Monument to graphic artists and painter

p5f7298742a.notes: Curved, scratched steel plaque at the Kārlis Padegs monument by a park fence, Riga, trilingual (lv/en/ru), with the Riga coat of arms below. Scratches cross some letters (e.g. the Л in КАРЛИСУ) but all text is readable. Note the plaque's own grammar 'graphic artists'.

pd35d36ed3a.notes: Monument to Colonel Oskars Kalpaks, Esplanāde park, Riga: light incised capitals on a long black granite base. A third line reads LATVIJAS ARMIJAS PIRMAJAM KOMANDIERIM as far as can be seen, but any macron/cedilla marks are too faint to confirm, so it is not in lines. Quote on the right: 'KO VARU VĒL TEV, TĒVZEME, / PAR SIRDI VAIRĀK DOT... / A. EGLĪTIS' (distractor). Wide shot; text occupies a small part of the frame.

pf85ab19627.notes: White raised letters and a round Baltic ornament on a black wooden board, Riga old town. A carved wooden animal sculpture in the foreground; small white round heritage plate (PK953 / 4410 / 114) and opening-hours board are distractors.

c14946353.notes: Old bilingual Latvian-Russian blue enamel street plate on a brick wall in Rēzekne.

c151508314.notes: White panel on a green Vidzeme tourist-map stand, with the castle name in Latvian and English. 'VIDZEME' map header, small web addresses and the wooden opening-hours board behind (repeating 'Lielstraupes pils / Lielstraupe Castle') are distractors.

c181584081.notes: Green 'Elis' letters on a yellow panel high on a round shop building, Vaidavas iela 12, Riga ('floor coverings and plumbing'); the macron on GRĪDAS is small. c181965164.notes: Green wooden barbershop at Tēriņu iela 65, Riga. Small blue house-number plate '65' at right is too small to read the street line.
